name: Object Input
description: Typed date, time and duration fields: locale-ordered numeric segments with a calendar dialog behind the date field.
notes: The batch plan listed card, form and locale_utils component deps; none is imported. Card chrome was old popover dressing, form integration comes from FormattedInput via the form_core primitive, and locale data comes from the localizations primitive.
The dialog dep is the pilot dialog (showShadcnDialog); theme capture across the route is handled there.

The calendar prompt resolves PromptMode.popover on desktop widths (>= 768 logical pixels) and dialog below; popover presentation needs an OverlayManager ancestor and reports selections live without closing.
No own theme file: visual styling is FormattedInputTheme, forwarded per widget via the theme arg.
